import collections, hashlib, json, math, os
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
R=Path("/home/z/workspace/deepfake_pipeline_reliability_v2_20261023")
V=Path("/home/z/workspace/deepfake_detector_publish_20261023/studies/pipeline_reliability/v2")
D=R/"data/H"; BACKUP=R/"backups/H_before_fresh_audit_20261023T1450Z/data/H"
E=R/"reports/H_production_data_independent_reconstruction_evidence_1450.json"
M=R/"reports/H_production_data_independent_reconstruction_method_1450.json"
P=R/"reports/H_production_data_independent_preliminary_1450.json"
errors=[]
def check(x,msg):
    if not x:errors.append(msg)
def sha(p):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(p).open("rb") as f:
        for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b""):h.update(b)
    return h.hexdigest()
def canon(x):return json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False)
def row_hash(rows):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    for row in rows:h.update(canon(row).encode()+b"\n")
    return h.hexdigest()
e=json.loads(E.read_text());pre=json.loads(P.read_text());method=json.loads(M.read_text())
check(sha(E)==pre["evidence"]["sha256"],"Independent reconstruction evidence changed")
check(sha(M)==pre["reproducible_method"]["sha256"],"Independent reconstruction method changed")

check(launch.get("returncode")==0 and launch.get("status")=="FRESH_FULL_AUDIT_COMMAND_COMPLETE","Fresh audit has not completed withrc0")
check(launch.get("pid")==152000,"Fresh audit process identity changed")

final_groups=json.loads((D/names[4]).read_text());coverage=json.loads((D/names[5]).read_text())

check(candidate.get("status")=="AUDIT_COMPLETE_READY_FOR_H_DATA_FREEZE_REVIEW","Fresh candidate status is not READY")

for obj,n in [(full,"full"),(integrity,"integrity"),(candidate,"candidate")]:
    check(obj.get("candidate_videos")==8431,n+" candidate count not8431")
    check(obj.get("data_frozen") is False,n+" unexpectedly marked frozen")

check(integrity.get("source_video_byte_hashes_verified")==8431,"Fresh audit source-byte count not8431")
check(full.get("source_videos_decoded")==integrity.get("source_videos_decoded")==0,"Unexpected source-video decode")
check(full.get("detector_calls")==0,"Fresh audit unexpectedly called detector")

check(full.get("geometry_protocol_sha256")==candidate.get("geometry_protocol_sha256")==e["geometry_protocol_sha256"],"Fresh protocol binding differs")
check(candidate.get("target_performance_used") is False,"Candidate used target scores")

("freeze_candidate_sha256",D/"H_data_freeze_candidate.json"),
("artifact_integrity_receipt_sha256",D/"H_artifact_integrity_receipt.json")]

check(len(paths)==len(set(paths))==8431,"Final paths not8431unique")
changed_manifests=[]

    metadata.update(json.dumps([str(p),h]).encode()+b"\n")
    if (i+1)%2000==0:print("final_metadata_hashes_checked",i+1,flush=True)

check(len(coverage)==len(coverage_map) and set(coverage_map)==set(expected_coverage),"Coverage role/method inventory differs")
float_deltas=[]
for key,want in expected_coverage.items():
    got=coverage_map.get(key,{})
    check(set(got)==set(want),"Coverage field set differs:"+str(key))
    for field,value in want.items():
        actual=got.get(field)
        if isinstance(value,float):
            good=isinstance(actual,(float,int)) and math.isclose(actual,value,rel_tol=1e-12,abs_tol=1e-12)
            check(good,"Coverage float differs:"+str(key)+"/"+field)
            if isinstance(actual,(float,int)):float_deltas.append(abs(actual-value))
        else:check(actual==value,"Coverage differs:"+str(key)+"/"+field)

tables={};table_results={};old_changes={}
active_rgb_roles=collections.defaultdict(set);active_rgb_labels=collections.defaultdict(set)
active_group_roles=collections.defaultdict(set);active_uid_roles=collections.defaultdict(set)
active_uid_set=set();unused=set(u for u,x in by_uid.items() if x["role"]=="SOURCE_UNUSED")
for key,want in e["expected_tables"].items():
    path=D/(key+".parquet");df=pd.read_parquet(path);records=df.to_dict("records");tables[key]=df
    actual_fp=row_hash(records);counts=df.groupby("video_uid",sort=False).size()
    table_bound=candidate["tables"][key]
    check(Path(table_bound["path"]).resolve()==path.resolve(),"Candidate table path differs:"+key)
    check(before[str(path)]==table_bound["sha256"]==full["tables"][key]["sha256"],"Final Parquet byte hash binding differs:"+key)
    check(list(df.columns)==want["columns"],"Ordered table columns differ:"+key)
    check(len(df)==want["rows"]==table_bound["rows"],"Final table row count differs:"+key)
    check(len(counts)==want["videos"]==table_bound["videos"],"Final video count differs:"+key)
    check(actual_fp==want["ordered_row_sha256"],"ALL-ROW fingerprint mismatch:"+key)
    check(set(df.video_uid)==set(want["video_uids"]),"Final UID cohort differs:"+key)
    check(hashlib.sha256(canon(sorted(counts.index)).encode()).hexdigest()==want["video_uid_sha256"],"Final UID hash mismatch:"+key)
    check(hashlib.sha256(canon(df.mother_id.tolist()).encode()).hexdigest()==want["mother_id_sha256"],"Final ordered mother hash mismatch:"+key)
    check(bool(counts.eq(8).all()) and not df.mother_id.duplicated().any(),"Final8mother cardinality differs:"+key)
    check(not df.isna().any().any(),"Final null row value:"+key)
    check(bool(df.groupby("video_uid").rgb_sha256.nunique().eq(8).all()) and bool(df.groupby("video_uid").mother_rgb_sha256.nunique().eq(8).all()),"Final8uniqueRGB differs:"+key)
    check(df.sample_id.equals(df.mother_id),"Final sample identity differs:"+key)
    check(not (set(df.video_uid)&unused),"SOURCE_UNUSED active in final table:"+key)
    check(not (set(df.video_uid)&set(e["quarantined_video_uids"])),"Quarantined UID active:"+key)
    expected_role=key.split("/")[-1].upper()
    check(set(df.role)=={expected_role},"Final role differs:"+key)
    check(all(by_uid[x.video_uid]["role"]==x.role and by_uid[x.video_uid]["label"]==x.label and by_uid[x.video_uid]["method"]==x.method_id for x in df.itertuples()),"Final row candidate role/label/method differs:"+key)
    for row in records:
        active_uid_set.add(row["video_uid"])
        active_group_roles[row["group_id"]].add(row["role"]);active_uid_roles[row["video_uid"]].add(row["role"])
        for field in ("mother_rgb_sha256","rgb_sha256"):
            active_rgb_roles[row[field]].add(row["role"]);active_rgb_labels[row[field]].add(row["label"])
    method_counts=dict(collections.Counter(df.method_id.tolist()[::8]))
    check(method_counts==want["video_counts_by_method"],"Final method video counts differ:"+key)
    old=BACKUP/(key+".parquet")
    if old.exists():
        old_df=pd.read_parquet(old);shared=[c for c in df if c in old_df]
        old_changes[key]=dict(old_sha256=sha(old),new_sha256=before[str(path)],byte_hash_changed=sha(old)!=before[str(path)],
            added_columns=[c for c in df if c not in old_df],removed_columns=[c for c in old_df if c not in df],
            UID_cohort_changed=set(old_df.video_uid)!=set(df.video_uid),
            ordered_shared_column_values_unchanged=row_hash(old_df[shared].to_dict("records"))==row_hash(df[shared].to_dict("records")))
    table_results[key]=dict(path=str(path),sha256=before[str(path)],rows=len(df),videos=len(counts),
        all_ordered_rows_equal_independent_reconstruction=actual_fp==want["ordered_row_sha256"],
        ordered_row_sha256=actual_fp,ordered_mother_id_sha256=want["mother_id_sha256"],
        video_uid_sha256=want["video_uid_sha256"],video_counts_by_method=method_counts)
check(all(len(x)<=1 for x in active_group_roles.values()),"Final active component role leakage")
check(all(len(x)<=1 for x in active_uid_roles.values()),"Final active UID role leakage")
check(all(len(x)<=1 for x in active_rgb_roles.values()),"Final active original/derived RGB role leakage")
check(all(len(x)<=1 for x in active_rgb_labels.values()),"Final active original/derived RGB label conflict")
paired_fields=["mother_id","sample_id","mother_rgb_sha256","mother_frame_index","mother_timestamp_seconds","video_uid","label","method_id","group_id","role","domain"]
pair_results={};weight_results={}
for role in ("TRAIN","DEV"):
    b=tables["B/"+role.lower()];ab=tables["AB/"+role.lower()]
    fields=paired_fields+["sampling_mass","method_contributions"]
    equal=b[fields].reset_index(drop=True).equals(ab[fields].reset_index(drop=True))
    check(equal,"Final paired training metadata differs:"+role)
    role_weights={}
    for ver,df in [("B",b),("AB",ab)]:
        video_counts=df.groupby("method_id").video_uid.nunique().to_dict()
        for m,n in video_counts.items():
            target=(.5 if m=="real" else .125)/n/8
            check(np.allclose(df.loc[df.method_id.eq(m),"sampling_mass"],target,rtol=0,atol=1e-14),"Final uniform method/video/frame mass differs:"+role+"/"+ver+"/"+m)
            for row in df.loc[df.method_id.eq(m)].itertuples():
                check(json.loads(row.method_contributions)=={m:target},"Final method contributions differ:"+role+"/"+ver)
        totals={m:math.fsum(df.loc[df.method_id.eq(m),"sampling_mass"]) for m in video_counts}
        check(all(math.isclose(totals[m],.5 if m=="real" else .125,rel_tol=0,abs_tol=1e-12) for m in totals),"Final method probabilities differ:"+role+"/"+ver)
        role_weights[ver]=dict(total_mass=math.fsum(df.sampling_mass),method_probability=totals,video_counts=video_counts)
    want=e["expected_training"][role];got=candidate["training"][role]
    for f in ("logical_mother_rows","draw_count","video_counts","paired_mother_ids_identical"):check(got[f]==want[f],"Candidate training budget/pairing differs:"+role+"/"+f)
    check(math.isclose(got["sampling_mass"],want["sampling_mass"],rel_tol=0,abs_tol=1e-12),"Candidate total sampling mass differs:"+role)
    for m in want["method_probability"]:check(math.isclose(got["method_probability"][m],want["method_probability"][m],rel_tol=0,abs_tol=1e-12),"Candidate method probability differs:"+role+"/"+m)
    pair_results[role]=equal;weight_results[role]=role_weights
for role in ("SOURCE_CAL","SOURCE_TEST","TARGET_TEST"):
    b=tables["B/"+role];cb=tables["common/B/"+role];ca=tables["common/AB/"+role]
    common_ids=set(cb.mother_id)
    check(cb.reset_index(drop=True).equals(b[b.mother_id.isin(common_ids)].reset_index(drop=True)),"Final common B not exact all-B subset:"+role)
    check(cb[paired_fields].reset_index(drop=True).equals(ca[paired_fields].reset_index(drop=True)),"Final common2x2 mother pairing differs:"+role)
    if role=="SOURCE_CAL":check(set(b.method_id)=={"real"} and set(b.label)=={0},"Final SOURCE_CAL not real-only")
    check(set(b.domain)=={"target" if role=="TARGET_TEST" else "source"},"Final evaluation domain differs:"+role)
for k,h in e["official_source_split_sha256"].items():
    check(sha(Path("/home/z/project/deepfake_detector/artifacts/data/source_splits")/(k+".json"))==h,"Official split file changed:"+k)
deep_launch_path=R/"reports/H_production_data_inspection_launch.json"
deep_launch=json.loads(deep_launch_path.read_text()) if deep_launch_path.exists() else {}
check(deep_launch.get("fresh_full_audit_sha256")==before[str(D/"H_full_candidate_audit_receipt.json")],"Deep inspector launched against another full-audit receipt")
check(deep_launch.get("data_gate_code_sha256")==before[str(V/"reliability_v2/data_h.py")],"Deep inspector data-gate code binding differs")
after={str(p):sha(p) for p in files}
check(before==after,"Final production evidence/table/code changed during independent verification")
deep_report=R/"reports/H_production_data_inspection.json"
deep_present=deep_report.exists()
binding=dict(candidate_sha256=before[str(D/"H_data_freeze_candidate.json")],
 full_audit_sha256=before[str(D/"H_full_candidate_audit_receipt.json")],
 tables_sha256={k:v["sha256"] for k,v in table_results.items()},
 geometry_code_sha256=before[str(V/"reliability_v2/geometry_h.py")],
 data_gate_code_sha256=before[str(V/"reliability_v2/data_h.py")],
 geometry_protocol_sha256=e["geometry_protocol_sha256"])
report=dict(schema="H_PRODUCTION_DATA_FINAL_TABLES_REVIEW_V1",
 status="BLOCKED_FINAL_TABLE_MISMATCH" if errors else "DEEP_INSPECTION_PENDING",
 reviewed_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),reviewer=e["reviewer"],
 production_acceptance=False,blockers=errors,all_final_table_checks_passed=not errors,
 independent_preliminary=dict(path=str(P),sha256=sha(P)),independent_reconstruction=dict(path=str(E),sha256=sha(E),method_path=str(M),method_sha256=sha(M)),
 fresh_audit_execution=dict(launch_path=str(launch_path),launch_sha256=before[str(launch_path)],pid=launch.get("pid"),returncode=launch.get("returncode"),ended_utc=launch.get("ended_utc")),
 candidate_videos=8431,source_unused_candidate_videos=560,final_tables=table_results,
 exact_bindings_for_eventual_production_review=binding,identities_sha256=after,
 metadata_manifest_inventory_sha256=inventory,artifact_inventory_sha256=integrity["artifact_inventory_sha256"],
 artifact_integrity_receipt_sha256=before[str(D/"H_artifact_integrity_receipt.json")],
 final_content_graph_exactly_equals_independent_BFS=audit==e["expected_content_audit"],
 final_groups_exactly_equal_independent_BFS=final_groups==e["expected_final_groups"],
 graph_counts=dict(unique_RGB_hashes=audit["unique_rgb_hashes"],RGB_group_edges=audit["rgb_group_edges"],
  source_group_components=audit["source_group_components"],cross_role_RGB_conflicts=len(audit["cross_role_rgb_conflicts"]),
  label_RGB_conflicts=len(audit["label_rgb_conflicts"]),source_group_role_conflicts=len(audit["source_group_role_conflicts"]),
  quarantined_videos=audit["quarantined_videos"],quarantined_groups=len(quarantine_ids) if "quarantine_ids" in globals() else candidate["quarantined_group_count"]),
 source_unused_bridge_counterfactual=e["source_unused_counterfactual"],
 paired_training_metadata_equal=pair_results,source_training_weights=weight_results,
 coverage=dict(role_method_cells=len(coverage),all_nonfloat_fields_exact=True,max_padding_mean_absolute_difference=max(float_deltas,default=0)),
 active_unique_video_count=len(active_uid_set),active_group_role_leaks=sum(len(x)>1 for x in active_group_roles.values()),
 active_RGB_role_leaks=sum(len(x)>1 for x in active_rgb_roles.values()),active_RGB_label_conflicts=sum(len(x)>1 for x in active_rgb_labels.values()),
 old_backup_differences=old_changes,
 no_final_evidence_or_code_change_during_review=before==after,
 pending_dependencies=[dict(action="Review actual data_h.inspect_h_data deep report and verify all receipt/table/code/inventory bindings",
  target=str(deep_report),state="AVAILABLE_NOT_YET_ACCEPTED" if deep_present else "PENDING",
  reason="Deep inspection must complete; this report intentionally does not assert production PASS")],
 deep_inspection_launch=dict(path=str(deep_launch_path),sha256=sha(deep_launch_path),record=deep_launch),
 scope=dict(CPU_only=True,threads=2,source_or_PNG_bytes_read=False,full_deep_scan_repeated=False,

 limitations=["The fresh full audit verified8431source-video byte hashes and469882existingPNG objects; this reviewer did not duplicate that full image scan.",

print(json.dumps(dict(report_path=str(out),report_sha256=sha(out),status=report["status"],blockers=errors,

 old_new_column_changes={k:{"added":x["added_columns"],"removed":x["removed_columns"],"UID_changed":x["UID_cohort_changed"],"shared_values_same":x["ordered_shared_column_values_unchanged"]} for k,x in old_changes.items()},
